Subject: Aligning next meeting cadence + evaluation rubric

Hi Carolyn —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and a suggested plan so we can lock the next steps: 

- What we heard: Clear Analytics wants predictable latency for batch embeddings and a simple way to run model comparisons on historical prompts. Primary success criteria: throughput >= 200 reqs/min, SLO for p95 latency < 300ms, and a short evaluation rubric for quality drift across model variants.
- Proposed next meeting: 60-minute session split into (1) 20–30m demo focused on runtime behavior for batch embeddings and (2) 30–40m technical deep dive on integration points (auth, VPC/private endpoints, KV cache).
- Suggested slots: Tue Dec 7 10:00–11:00 PST or Wed Dec 8 14:00–15:00 PST. Please tell us which works or propose two alternatives.

Can you also introduce the person on your side who owns security evidence and the procurement contact so we can get the checklist and contract path in motion? I’ve attached a short post-call recap and the discovery notes.

Attachments: redwood-postcall-recap-20271204.pdf

Next steps from our side: I’ll loop in our security lead (Marissa) and solutions engineer (Karthik) once we confirm a time. If it helps, we can provide a lightweight evaluation rubric ahead of the demo so your team knows what to expect and can prepare test prompts.

Thanks,
Jonas
